# `armadad backup`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

Writes a consistent backup of the control plane: a snapshot of the state
(etcd), the secrets master key, the cluster CA, the server certificate,
ACME certificates, and this node's agent identity. Safe to run while the
server is running.

The archive contains the CA key and the master key in plaintext. It is
created with mode 0600; encrypt it before it leaves the machine, e.g.

  armadad backup -o - | age -r age1... > armada-$(date +%F).tar.gz.age

```
armadad backup -o FILE [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir string` | control plane data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
| `-o`, `--output string` | archive to create (never overwritten), or - for stdout |
